_comment: F42: logistic weights for each perceptual axis over the derived feature vector app/color/perceptual.py's _progression_features() builds from F41's measurable axes plus a few token-metadata flags. Every weight carries a one-line rationale so the formula stays auditable, not just tuned. value = sigmoid(bias + sum(feature * weight)).

any_borrowed.rationale: Modal mixture (borrowing from the parallel key) is the classic harmonic device for a wistful, 'looking back' color.

has_modal_cadence.rationale: A cadence built from borrowed subdominant/submediant chords (minor plagal, Aeolian, backdoor) is a well-known nostalgic cadential fingerprint.

mean_brightness01.rationale: Darker, minor-leaning harmony reads as wistful more often than bright major harmony.

mean_smoothness.rationale: Gentle, mostly stepwise voice leading feels sentimental rather than jarring.

mean_brightness01.rationale: Melancholy is centrally a darkness/minor-mode read of the harmony.

mean_tension.rationale: A little unresolved tension reads as aching rather than settled.

mean_resolution.rationale: A strong, clean cadential resolution reads as content, not melancholy.

any_borrowed.rationale: Borrowed minor-mode color often carries a melancholic tinge even in a major-key song.

mean_brightness01.rationale: Major-leaning, consonant harmony is the core signal for a warm sound.

mean_stability.rationale: Settled, tonic-leaning harmony feels comforting rather than unsettled.

mean_tension.rationale: Dissonance and unresolved drive read as cold or anxious, not warm.

any_chromatic.rationale: Chromatic motion outside the usual mixture/applied vocabulary reads as less cozy and more unsettled.

mean_complexity.rationale: Extended and added-tone chords (7ths, 9ths) are the classic hazy, impressionistic color device.

has_extension.rationale: The mere presence of any chord extension is itself a strong dreamy-voicing signal.

mean_tension.rationale: Dreaminess tends to read as soft and floating, not actively tense.

mean_smoothness.rationale: Slow-moving, floating voice leading supports a hazy feel.

mean_resolution.rationale: An open-ended progression avoids strongly closing off; the more resolved, the less open.

max_finality.rationale: A progression that lands hard on a root-position tonic is the opposite of open-ended.

has_deceptive.rationale: Deceptive motion is a textbook way to keep a phrase open rather than closing it.

mean_stability.rationale: Constant tonic stability reads as settled and closed, not open.

any_borrowed.rationale: Modal-mixture color (borrowed chords) is a signature epic/cinematic scoring device.

has_modal_cadence.rationale: Aeolian and backdoor-style cadences are a common film-score cadential fingerprint.

mean_chromaticity.rationale: Chromatic color outside the plain diatonic set reads as more dramatic and widescreen.

mean_tension.rationale: A degree of harmonic tension supports a sense of scale and drama.
